_comment: Set active_workflow and primary_metric before your first run. engine-setup fills this in with you.
_active_workflow_options: seo, linkedin, video, outreach — or any custom workflow you scaffolded
_primary_metric_guidance: The one number the loop optimises, workspace-wide. Use something real: replies, signups, demos, clicks, watch_through_rate. Not 'engagement'. A channel can override it with its own primary_metric key (see _channel_keys) — do that when you run workflows with different currencies, e.g. seo (clicks) + outreach (replies).
_channels_note: NOT a fixed set — add channels freely (newsletter, threads, bluesky, reddit, podcast, ...). runlog.py --channel is free text; a channel only needs an entry here if you want config for it.
_channel_keys: Optional per-channel keys the scripts honour: primary_metric (overrides the global one for runs on this channel) and metric_delay_hours (how long after publish before the number is worth reading — due_metrics.py defaults to 72, right for social; set e.g. 336 for blog/Search Console, 24 for email replies).
_publish_note: Advisory, and an open set — no script enforces it. The contract is: a human approves before anything goes live, and the URL gets recorded. 'api' means the agent may publish directly after approval (sanctioned APIs only, e.g. Bluesky's AT Protocol); map any scheduler you already use onto the same contract.

video._note: Knobs engine-video reads. 9:16 vertical is the default, not a law — set 1920x1080 for a YouTube-landscape strategy and say so in brand.md.

cadence._note: Advisory — read by you and your agent when scheduling (see engine-loop/references/scheduling.md), not enforced by any script.
